items.text: REFERRED TO MENTAL HEALTH AND DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES

items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the mental hygiene law, the banking law and the tax law, in relation to establishing the NY ABLE act
items.lawCode: Add Art 84 §§84.01 - 84.11, Ment Hyg L; amd §237, Bank L; amd §612, Tax L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S1006

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the mental hygiene law, the banking
law and the tax law, in relation to establishing the NY ABLE act

PURPOSE:

To establish the New York State Achieving Better Life Experience
Accounts for individuals with intellectual and developmental
disabilities.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 is the short title,.

Section 2 is the legislative intent for the creation of ABLE accounts.

Section 3 amends the mental hygiene law by addition a new article 84.

84.03 Establishes definitions for this act.

84.05 Requires the commissioner of the office of people with
developmental disabilities to establish the ABLE accounts plans for
eligible individuals with the goal and purpose of supporting
individuals with disabilities to maintain health, independence, and
quality of life.

84.09 Provides the distribution requirements and qualified expenses
which at a minimum shall include the following;

-Tuition,
-Education Materials and services,
-Housing expenses for a primary residence including; *Real Property
Taxes, and

*Utility Charges.

-Mass Transit,
-Vehicle,
-Expenses related to obtaining and maintaining employment,
-Health,
-Prevention and Wellness.
-Expenses including:

*Insurance Premiums,

*Rehabilitation Services.

*Durable Medical Equipment, and

*Nutritional Management

-Any other expense the Commissioner of OPWDD deems qualified.

84.1 1 is the powers of the comptroller


Section 4 amends section 237 of the banking law to designate the
superintendent of financial services to promulgate rules and
regulations to allow a savings bank to act as trustee of an ABLE
account.

Section 5 amends subsection (c) of section 612 of the tax law is
amended by adding two new paragraphs.

Section 6 is the effective date.

JUSTIFICATION:

The purpose of this legislation is to create New York State Achieving
Better Life Experience (ABLE) accounts to encourage and assist
individuals and families in saving private funds for the purpose of
supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental
disabilities to maintain health, independence and quality of life.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

Same as S.7937-2014

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

Minimal.

EFFECTIVE DATE:

This act shall take effect on the one hundred eightieth day after it
shall become a law; provided, however, that effective immediately, the
addition, amendment and/or repeal of any rules or regulations
necessary for the implementation of this act on its effective date are
authorized and directed to be made and completed on or before such
effective date.

summary: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act to support individuals with disabilities to maintain health, independence and quality of life.
